name: sdf-iris
title: SDF Iris
description: Aspect-corrected circle SDF opening from center. Triple onion ring glow with warm exponential falloff. Plays between two built-in panels (A and B) that a host swaps for its own scenes: copy the fragment shader into your composition and feed it your two frames as textures.
useWhen: A circular reveal that opens from the centre of the frame with a warm, triple-ringed glow along the edge.
A classic iris cut that should feel lit rather than flat.
avoidWhen: A flat, graphic iris on a solid colour: use iris-wipe.
author: HeyGen (Hyperframes)
